title: Just breathe
line: Five minutes of breath and nothing else. For anyone, of any faith or none.
intro: No god is invoked here, and nothing is asked of you except to breathe. This is the oldest practice there is, and the one every tradition shares.

steps.title: Arrive
steps.text: Sit or lie comfortably. Follow the circle: in as it grows, out as it settles.

steps.title: Let the out-breath lengthen
steps.text: Now let each out-breath be a little longer than the in-breath. This is how the body learns that it is safe.

steps.title: Notice
steps.text: Without changing anything, notice how you are now.
steps.prompt: One word for how I am, right now.

after: That is the whole practice. You can come back to it any time, anywhere.
